classification: CONFIRMATORY test of a hypothesis that was generated post hoc. Rollout-time intervention only: no training, no checkpoint write, no parameter change.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-21 ('96 seeds, J primary, four signs secondary, two-opponent wording, GO'): run a fresh-seed goal-volume confirmation of the native vs +1-defender intervention on both certified 6v6 poles, with Blue goals per episode as the sole primary endpoint, the pole interaction J per learned policy as the primary criterion, margin as a consistency check only, and the four cell directions as a secondary replication requirement.
HYPOTHESIS: For the frozen learned checkpoints pi_A and pi_B, forcing exactly one policy-external defender changes Blue goal production differently against the two certified 6v6 opponents: it raises it against Pole A and lowers it against Pole B.

ORIGIN_IS_POST_HOC.statement: The hypothesis was generated after the sealed causal bridge (DEFENDER_INJECTION_CAUSAL_BRIDGE_RESULT.json, win-rate endpoint, ONE_DEFENDER_HARM_ONLY) and the exploratory records EXPLORATORY_ONE_DEFENDER_FAILURE_LOCALIZATION_* and DESCRIPTIVE_ONE_DEFENDER_GOAL_VOLUME_ADDENDUM_*, all on seeds 20900001-20900096. The effect directions were chosen after seeing those data, so the exploratory estimates are optimistic (selection).
ORIGIN_IS_POST_HOC.consequence: Those seeds contribute nothing to this confirmation. Every episode analysed here is drawn from the fresh block below, which no earlier record has used or seen.

MECHANISM_UNCHANGED.statement: Exactly the intervention of the causal bridge: experiments.probe_learned_composition.install_forced_defend_target patches the resolved-target layer of one agent so it takes MacroAction.DEFEND's live-state target, calling the real _build_targets_from_action a second time, never writing commit_macro. Rotation of the overridden agent is seed % 6, the same id at a given seed for both policies and both poles.

source_pin.note: byte-identical to the file that ran the causal bridge (last changed in commit 0197e65c). The contracts stage refuses to run if this hash differs.

MECHANISM_UNCHANGED.behaviour_reverified: the contracts stage re-runs the scripted-DEFEND equivalence check (bit-for-bit, n_macros 5 and 8) on two fresh (pole, agent-id) cells before any seed is spent.

DESIGN.pole_meaning: the two certified 6v6 Red strategy classes: Pole A = OP6 with its frozen overlay, Pole B = canonical OP7. No third certified 6v6 opponent exists in the repository.

fresh_seed_block.disjoint_from: every prior block in this line (13680001-128, 20700001-016, 20700101-228, 20800001-016, 20900001-096) and every other registered block

DESIGN.n_episodes: 2 policies x 2 poles x 2 arms x 96 seeds = 768 FULL episodes (not truncated), deterministic actions, cuda, torch.no_grad().
DESIGN.pairing: the same 96 seed values in every cell and both arms, so every difference below is paired by seed.

ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.primary_endpoint: Blue goals per episode, G. It is the SOLE primary endpoint.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.cell_effect: Delta G_{p,r} = G_{p,r,+1D} - G_{p,r,native}, per seed then averaged, for each learned policy p and pole r in {A, B}.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.interaction: J_p = Delta G_{p,A} - Delta G_{p,B}, computed per seed as [G(p,A,+1D,s) - G(p,A,native,s)] - [G(p,B,+1D,s) - G(p,B,native,s)] and then bootstrapped over the 96 seeds. One J per learned policy.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.statistics: paired bootstrap 95% interval over seeds, the routine and settings used throughout this line (20000 resamples, alpha 0.05, rng seed 7).
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.margin: score margin (Blue - Red) is reported beside Blue goals for every cell and for J, as a CONSISTENCY CHECK ONLY. Red scores almost never, so margin is nearly the same statistic as Blue goals; it is never counted as a second confirmation and never enters a label.

PRIMARY_CRITERION_FROZEN.why_J_and_not_a_four_cell_conjunction: From the exploratory rows (per-seed SD of the paired cell effects 1.2-1.4 goals), at 96 seeds and a true effect 60% of the exploratory estimate, J for both policies has power ~0.97, while requiring all four cell effects to resolve individually has power ~0.30. Requiring four individually significant cells would smuggle the underpowered conjunction back in after choosing J as primary, so it is not required.

SECONDARY_REPLICATION_REQUIREMENT_FROZEN.rule: The four fresh cell POINT ESTIMATES reproduce the pre-registered directions: Delta G_{pi_A,A} > 0, Delta G_{pi_B,A} > 0, Delta G_{pi_A,B} < 0, Delta G_{pi_B,B} < 0. Strict inequalities on point estimates; an estimate of exactly zero fails its sign.
SECONDARY_REPLICATION_REQUIREMENT_FROZEN.not_required: that any individual cell interval excludes zero.

precedence: AUDIT_FAILED (sealed status != SEALED) overrides everything below and certifies no label
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.OPPONENT_CONDITIONED_GOAL_INTERACTION_CO: Both J lower bounds exceed zero AND all four cell point estimates reproduce the frozen signs.
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.INTERACTION_CONFIRMED_PATTERN_PARTIAL: Both J lower bounds exceed zero, but one or more cell point estimates fail the predicted sign. The interaction replicates; the specific A-positive / B-negative story does not fully replicate.
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.OPPONENT_CONDITIONED_GOAL_INTERACTION_NO: Either policy's J lower bound is not above zero.
TERMINAL_OUTCOMES_FROZEN.always_reported: all four cell effects with intervals and native / +1D means, both J with intervals, the margin counterparts, and which of the four signs reproduced, whichever label results.

INTERPRETATION_GUARD_FROZEN.sentence: A positive J establishes differential intervention response between the two certified opponents. It does not distinguish opponent-specific strategic sensitivity from regression/compression toward a common goal-production level.
INTERPRETATION_GUARD_FROZEN.wording: Any confirmed claim is worded 'opponent-conditioned across the two certified 6v6 poles'. It is not worded 'regime-conditioned', and it does not claim to rule out compression: natively the poles differ (about 1.1 vs 2.3 goals) while under +1D both landed near 1.8-2.0 goals in the exploratory data, and two poles cannot separate those readings.

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_SEED_IS_SPENT: the mechanism source hash equals the pin above
scripted-DEFEND equivalence re-verified on two fresh (pole, id) cells at n_macros 5 and 8
seed rotation exactly uniform over the block
checkpoint hashes equal the pinned values
the block is reserved to this experiment as sealed_confirmatory, unspent, and disjoint from every prior block
the real runner never writes a raw macro or commit tensor for the overridden agent
the terminal-outcome rule, implemented as a pure function, returns the frozen label on synthetic cases (including an exact-zero cell and a single failing J)
RUN_CONDITIONS_FROZEN: no PPO, no extra arm, no alternative defender count, no routing
no interim inspection of outcomes (progress COUNTS may be watched), no early stopping, no top-up of the seed block
sharding across processes with an append-only resume file per shard is an execution detail only: episodes are independent and deterministic, so it cannot change any result
the analysis stage refuses to run unless all 768 cells are present, and is sealed through the formal audit pipeline (rows, checkpoints, seed class, per-cell claims re-derived from the rows)
NOT_AUTHORIZED: using seeds 20900001-20900096 for any part of this confirmation
adding endpoints, cells, or a second vote (margin) after seeing the result
requiring individual cell significance after having chosen J as primary
wording the outcome as regime-conditioned or as ruling out compression
replacing or re-scoring any earlier sealed record
claim_boundary: Two frozen learned checkpoints, two certified 6v6 opponents, rollout-time intervention only, fresh seeds spent for the first time here. Establishes (or fails to establish) a differential response of Blue goal production to a forced defender across those two opponents.
claim_ceiling: At most: OPPONENT_CONDITIONED_GOAL_INTERACTION_CONFIRMED across the two certified 6v6 poles. Not a general regime law, not a win-probability claim, not a mechanism, not evidence about a retrained policy, and not a discrimination of opponent-specific sensitivity from compression.
